name: HIGHROLLER GOLD
tagline: Gold bells, velvet keys, brass, organ, strings and gold sub: 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: Bells, keys, brass, organ, strings and 808 sub
gumroad_title: HIGHROLLER GOLD - Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Keys, Brass, Organ, Bells, 808
summary: A synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (gold bell, velvet keys, big band brass, organ, mallets, strings, gold sub and smoky pad) and 70 factory presets.
about: HIGHROLLER GOLD, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH, TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter with its own envelope, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.

The 70 presets are organized in seven banks of ten: bells and jackpot sounds, velvet keys, big band brass, organ, mallets and strings, gold sub and bass, and smoky pads. The ten Gold Sub & Bass presets and one brass preset load in Mono mode; the others load in Poly mode, which plays up to 16 voices.
Built for Hip-Hop, Trap and R&B keys and hooks, lounge and soul chords, brass stabs, bell toplines, pads and 808-style subs.

features.d: Gold bell, velvet keys, big band brass, organ, mallets, strings, gold sub and smoky pad.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from jackpot bells to cigar smoke pads.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated ADSR.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 48 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: HIGHROLLER GOLD plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .hgpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
